message: So there I was, huddled in my living room during last week's storm, surrounded by snacks and a cozy blanket. I glanced at my phone and saw the family group chat buzzing with messages—everyone sharing their favorite comfort foods and old storm stories. It reminded me that while we might be preparing for the worst, a little humor and connection can really lighten the mood. How does your family stay in touch during stormy weather? 🌀
